corrected_defects.finding: The structural-assurance summary recorded an incorrect uncompressed ledger SHA-256 and size.
corrected_defects.resolution: Recomputed the decoded ledger hash and size from the committed deterministic gzip/base64 bytes; focused and full tests passed afterward.

corrected_defects.finding: The exact chronology projection rejected historical UI-only fixtures that contained chronological display-time rows but no immutable C2 row identities.
corrected_defects.resolution: Preserved the strict exact-C2 path and added a fail-closed legacy path that accepts only already-chronological display rows and never reorders or identity-aligns them.

corrected_defects.finding: The PD-G0 outcome-field guard swept later assurance and authority schemas, conflating explicit denied-authority fields with operational outcome fields.
corrected_defects.resolution: Scoped the guard to the exact four operational schemas frozen by the PD-G0 gate packet; PD-G0 and PD-WP4 workflows then passed.
